## What it is

- The **DM-2** was made from **1981** to 1984 (Guitar World).
- Delay **20 to 300 ms** (Boss, on the DM-2W reissue's Standard mode).
- Three knobs: **Repeat Rate** (clockwise = shorter), **Echo** (how loud the repeats are), **Intensity** (how many; fully left = one repeat) (Boss).

## How it makes its sound

- A bucket-brigade chip of many stages (4096 in the MN3005, from a seller's listing: unverified) delays the signal by stages ÷ (2 × clock rate). A long delay needs a slow clock, and a slow clock passes less treble: long delays are darker.
- Each repeat goes round the chip again: through the filter again, so every repeat is darker than the one before (Guitar World: "darker and warmer").
- Intensity near full: the repeats stop dying away and build into a howl (self-oscillation, Guitar World).

## The pedal

The Boss DM-2 Delay's face, drawn after photos (positions approximate, no logos). Drag a knob (or use the arrow keys), click the footswitch to bypass, then press a ▶ button. The guitar is this site's pickup model (pick one, and its volume, below the buttons); the sound goes through the pedal model, then a clean amp. Nobody has compared it with a real pedal. The picture shows the waveform going in and coming out.

## Guided tour

```{=html}
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="dm2" data-set="{&quot;rate&quot;:7,&quot;echo&quot;:6,&quot;intensity&quot;:2}" data-play="pluck"><p><b>Short slapback.</b> One note, a quick repeat.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="dm2" data-set="{&quot;rate&quot;:2,&quot;echo&quot;:6,&quot;intensity&quot;:5}" data-play="pluck"><p><b>Long delay, more repeats.</b> Listen: each repeat darker.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="dm2" data-set="{&quot;rate&quot;:4,&quot;echo&quot;:5,&quot;intensity&quot;:0}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Intensity 0.</b> Just one repeat.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="dm2" data-set="{&quot;rate&quot;:3,&quot;echo&quot;:8,&quot;intensity&quot;:10}" data-play="pluck"><p><b>Intensity 10.</b> It runs away (turn your speakers down).</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="dm2" data-set="{&quot;rate&quot;:4,&quot;echo&quot;:5,&quot;intensity&quot;:3}" data-play="lead"><p><b>On a lead line.</b></p></div>
```
